description: Get one config by slug and return its routing, cache, retry, and target settings. Requires a known slug; use list_configs to discover one before editing.

slug.description: The unique identifier (slug) of the configuration to retrieve. This can be found in the configuration's URL or from the list_configs tool response

name: get_config

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
